note: Dispatch surface of the specialized top-p renorm kernel (flashinfer._top_p_renorm_specialized, behind flashinfer.sampling.top_p_renorm_probs): exact (batch_size, vocab_size) rows of float32 probabilities with a per-row float32 top_p tensor and is_deterministic=False, on compute capability 10.3. Every other call takes the stock AIR top-p path. The kernel itself is parametric in batch_size and vocab_size (one module, no per-shape compilation); this list only bounds where it is dispatched. Peaked rows whose nucleus lies entirely in entries >= 2^-8 can take the head-entry fast path. Rows whose nucleus extends below that threshold take the radix path.
